_what: A recorded snapshot of which Cloudflare resources actually exist on the account. It is the offline oracle for scripts/analysis/bindings/check-bindings.mjs, so that gate runs in CI with no credentials and no network.
_why: gateway/wrangler.jsonc bound MAIN_APP to `hlada-api` — a Worker that has never existed — and nothing caught it, because nothing compared config against reality. A binding that names a nonexistent resource is a deploy-time or run-time failure that looks like a working config file.
_how_to_refresh: From an authenticated session, READ-ONLY: `wrangler deployments list --name <worker>` per Worker (code 10007 means it does not exist), `wrangler queues list`, `wrangler r2 bucket list`. Update capturedAtUtc. Never record a secret VALUE — names only, and this file records no secrets at all.
accountNote: Single account. Account id deliberately omitted — it is not needed by the gate.
